$note: Read at startup by every installed Vtruvian, and re-read every 30 minutes. Editing this file reaches every installation at its next check. Fail-open by design: if this file is unreachable, missing or invalid, nothing is restricted.

$keys.minimum: Oldest version still allowed to run. Anything older is asked to update. Omit to allow every version.
$keys.capabilities: Capability name -> false to switch it off. Absent means on.
$keys.message: Shown to the architect when 'minimum' refuses their build.
